title: 人物＋真实场地
roles: 草坪、座椅、花拱门与环境
request: Image 1 supplies only the couple, their facial features, hairstyle, relative height, wedding clothing, bouquet and mutual gaze. Image 2 supplies the actual outdoor wedding venue, seating, aisle, arch and vegetation. Create ONE unified isometric paper miniature of this couple standing at this ceremony venue. Preserve the recognizable arrangement and distinctive structures from Image 2; use the actual venue rather than inventing a generic wedding backdrop. No additional people. This is a fictional combination of independently sourced photographs, not evidence these people visited this venue.

title: 故事一幕：一起喝咖啡
roles: 同一对成年人物的身份参考
request: Create ONE miniature story vignette: the same adult couple from Image 1 sit opposite each other at a small cafe table, looking at one another over coffee. Use the cup, saucer and wood table cues from Image 2, with two place settings. The man's dark hair and beard and the woman's facial features and brown hairstyle should remain recognizable. Change wedding clothing to simple casual everyday clothing appropriate to the cafe; do not add other people. This cafe episode is an expressly fictional illustrative scenario, not a biographical claim. Keep only a small table, two chairs and a restrained fragment of cafe setting on one paper base.

title: 故事另一幕：一起去海边
roles: 同一对成年人物的身份参考
沙滩、球网和岸边建筑；不采用该照片人物
request: Create ONE miniature story vignette: the same adult couple from Image 1 walk hand in hand on a small beach scene derived from Image 2. All identities, facial features and hairstyles come from Image 1; do not import the blond woman or the other man from Image 2. Dress the pair in simple casual clothes for a beach walk. Use sand, the yellow beach net and low pale shoreline building as scene cues; keep the paper island compact and restrained. This is a fictional travel episode, not a record that these people took this trip. Show the pair in a three-quarter view so their faces remain visible enough to compare with the cafe vignette.

title: 把几个生活地点放到一张地图
request: Create ONE coherent isometric paper miniature memory map with four small recognizable zones connected by a restrained winding paper path on a single contiguous base: a cafe table using Image 1; a home kitchen using Image 2; a beach using Image 3; and a wedding ceremony lawn using Image 4. Depict no people in this overview. Keep zones small, balanced and readable with whitespace; this local scene-organization extension explicitly permits four focal zones rather than a single isolated subject. Do not create separate panels, a photo collage, text or labels. This is a conceptual arrangement of life themes, not a geographically accurate map and not the documented life of any real person.

title: 把真实厨房做成空间纪念
roles: 四个人、厨房构件及相对位置
request: Create ONE restrained isometric cutaway paper miniature of the visible kitchen in Image 1. Preserve exactly the four people, their clothing colors and meal-preparation relationships. Ground the geometry in the visible island, cabinetry, black-and-gold hood, pendant lamps and countertop. Keep the counter objects related to the photo. Do not add decorative plants, stools, carpets, extra rooms or additional people. Where rear or lower surfaces cannot be seen, keep them simple rather than inventing a detailed house. This is a visual interpretation from a single photo, not measured architectural reconstruction.

title: 局部定制：只改花艺颜色
direction: 已有微缩图的局部编辑
roles: 本轮场地微缩图，编辑目标
request: The attached image is an existing finished miniature artwork to EDIT, not a source photograph to transform again. Preserve its canvas, framing, camera angle, paper base, people, facial features, clothing, poses, chairs, arch geometry, paths, lighting and all other elements. Change ONLY the flower petals in the ceremony arch and ground floral arrangements to a soft pale-blue color. Preserve green foliage and the bride's bouquet exactly as before. Do not add or remove objects. No text. This is a local customization demonstration. The pale-blue replacement is the current explicit color change; do not apply a whole-image tint or restyle the scene.
